create_dqn_agent: create a DQN agent in JAX for reinforcement learning in open_spiel games with configurable hyperparameters
build_replay_buffer: build a JAX-compatible replay buffer with FIFO replacement policy for uniform sampling of transitions
train_dqn_agent: train a DQN agent by adding transitions to the replay buffer and performing Q-network updates on sampled batches
select_epsilon_greedy_action: select an epsilon-greedy action from a Q-network given an info state and legal actions mask
save_load_dqn_checkpoint: save and load DQN agent checkpoints including Q-network weights and optimizer state using Orbax
